_help: Hand-curated outside events. Add one object per event. Times are local Eastern. Use "allDay": true and a date-only "start" (YYYY-MM-DD) for all-day events. category: area | benefits | community | post. Always include the organizer's page in "url" so members can confirm details.

events.title: VA Providence Employment Resource Center Veteran Job Fair
events.location: Providence VA Medical Center, Main Building 5th Floor Classrooms, 830 Chalkstone Ave, Providence
events.description: Free job fair connecting veterans with local employers. Contact the Employment Resource Center at 401-273-7100 ext. 13491.

events.title: Vet Cafe - Burrillville
events.location: 111 Chapel Street, Burrillville, RI 02830
events.description: Drop-in resource cafe for veterans hosted by the RI Office of Veterans Services, with staff on hand to answer questions about benefits and services.

events.title: The Dinner Circle: Island Soul
events.location: VFW Post 4651, 7 Haven Ave, Cranston, RI 02920
events.description: Three-course, family-style dinner at the Post with Caribbean flavors, cooked by Chef Kimberly Andrade (Chef's Soulful Compass). Come solo, with friends or as a date night; 21+. $35 per person; tickets through Eventbrite. The menu is set, so anyone with food allergies or dietary needs should contact the chef before buying.

events.title: Providence During the Revolutionary War Walking Tour with Scott Alexander
events.location: The Museum at the John Brown House, 52 Power Street, Providence, RI 02906
events.description: Rhode Island Historical Society walking tour of Revolutionary War-era Providence, led by historian Scott Alexander. Registration through the event page.

events.title: A Concert for Freedom: Revolutionary Black & White Voices
events.location: First Baptist Church in America, 75 North Main Street, Providence, RI
events.description: Free and open to the public. The Schiller Institute Chorus sings Revolutionary-era African American spirituals, with dramatic readings from the writings of Rhode Island patriots, writers and thinkers that bring out underrepresented voices in America's founding. Presented by Stages of Freedom with the RI 250 Commission as the closing event of Rhode Island's Semiquincentennial, with support from the RI State Council on the Arts.

events.title: Full Moon Hike (Weekend Warriors of New England)
events.location: Rhode Island (venue via organizer registration page)
events.description: Evening full moon hike for veterans hosted by Weekend Warriors of New England, listed on RI Office of Veterans Services' events calendar.

events.title: VA Providence Fall VetConnect
events.location: VA Providence Healthcare System, 830 Chalkstone Avenue, Providence, RI
events.description: Veterans and families join VA Providence leadership for updates on programs and to connect with representatives from VA Enrollment and the Veterans Benefits Administration.

events.title: Feed Dating: Around the World in 8 Dates
events.location: VFW Post 4651, 7 Haven Ave, Cranston, RI 02920
events.description: Culinary speed dating at the Post, hosted by Chef Kimberly Andrade (Chef's Soulful Compass). Eight 10-minute dates over six internationally inspired tasting courses. Limited to 8 women and 8 men; 21+. $75 per person, with an optional $5 donation to the Post; tickets through Eventbrite. The menu is fixed and cannot accommodate allergies or dietary restrictions.

events.title: '80s Halloween Party at the Post
events.location: VFW Post 4651, 7 Haven Ave, Cranston, RI 02920
events.description: Back-to-the-'80s Halloween party inside the Post, hosted by Jessica and Marissa. Costumes encouraged, with music, contests and prizes.

events.title: From Slaves to Soldiers: The 1st Rhode Island Regiment, with Robert A. Geake
events.location: North Kingstown Town Hall (2nd Floor), 80 Boston Neck Road, North Kingstown, RI
events.description: HistWick Speaker Series talk on the 1st Rhode Island Regiment — the Continental Army unit of African American and Native American enlisted men known as the Black Regiment — presented by historian and author Robert A. Geake.

events.title: The Dinner Circle: Night in New Orleans
events.location: VFW Post 4651, 7 Haven Ave, Cranston, RI 02920
events.description: Three-course, family-style dinner at the Post with Louisiana dishes, cooked by Chef Kimberly Andrade (Chef's Soulful Compass). Come solo, with friends or as a date night; 21+. $35 per person; tickets through Eventbrite. The menu is set, so anyone with food allergies or dietary needs should contact the chef before buying.

events.title: Trivia Night at the Post
events.location: VFW Post 4651, 7 Haven Ave, Cranston, RI 02920
events.description: Weekly trivia night at the Post, hosted by Logiq & Kobi D. with music by DJ Rukiz. Teams of four, three rounds, one winner each week; categories include music, TV theme songs, movies, sports and general knowledge. Doors open at 7 p.m.; trivia starts at 8. Free admission. The 10-week season ends with a finale for a $500 prize.

events.title: Westerly Veterans Day Parade
events.location: Westerly, RI (organized by the Ocean Community Chamber of Commerce)
events.description: Check the organizer's page for the route and step-off point.

events.title: WaterFire Salute to Veterans (14th annual)
events.location: State House to WaterPlace Park, Providence
events.description: Opening ceremonies at the State House, torch procession, Veterans Resource Fair on Washington Street (3:00-10:00 p.m.), military vehicle display, memorial tributes at sunset and a Memorial Canoe Ceremony. About 150 veterans serve as torchbearers; sign-up and mobility assistance are on the event page.

events.title: Nathanael Greene, Rhode Island, and the Race to the Dan with Andrew Waters
events.location: Aldrich House, 110 Benevolent Street, Providence, RI 02906
events.description: Rhode Island Historical Society talk by author Andrew Waters on how Nathanael Greene's Rhode Island upbringing shaped his Revolutionary War leadership, focusing on his Race to the Dan retreat across the Carolinas. Registration through the event page.

events.title: Veterans Day Free Dental Clinic for Veterans
events.location: Newport Family & Cosmetic Dentistry, Newport, RI
events.description: Free cleanings, X-rays, exams, fillings and extractions for veterans on Veterans Day. For veterans only; appointments required — call 401-250-2005.

events.title: Cranston Veterans Day Parade
events.location: Starts on Doric Avenue behind the Pub on Park, along Park Avenue to Pontiac Avenue, north on Rolfe Street to Rolfe Square, followed by a ceremony at the Cannon Memorial, Cranston
events.description: Annual Veterans Day parade and ceremony revived as a Cranston tradition. Time/route based on the 2025 running; check the city's page closer to the date for any changes.

events.title: VFW Post 449 Turkey Trot
events.location: VFW Post 449, 197 Providence Street, West Warwick, RI
events.description: Community Turkey Trot event hosted by VFW Post 449.

events.title: 2026 Veterans Appreciation Dinner
events.location: West Warwick Elks #1697, 60 Clyde St., West Warwick, RI 02893
events.description: "Let Us Serve You!" A dinner for veterans: half chicken, roasted potatoes, mixed vegetables, rolls and Greek salad. Veterans free; non-veterans $15; children $10. Tickets are on sale through Donald Torpey.

events.title: Breakfast & Toy Drive for the Sgt. Brian St. Germain Foundation and Toys for Tots
events.location: West Warwick Elks, 60 Clyde Street, West Warwick, RI 02893
events.description: Holiday breakfast with Santa and raffles benefiting the Sergeant Brian St. Germain Foundation and the U.S. Marine Corps Reserve Toys for Tots program. $10 per person; children under 5 free. Buy tickets or donate through the Foundation's PayPal link. Bring a new, unwrapped toy for the Toys for Tots bin (optional).
events.source: Sgt. Brian St. Germain Foundation (event flyer)

events.title: 2nd Annual Connecticut Colored Regiments Memorial Walk
events.location: Connecticut's Old State House, 800 Main St, Hartford, CT 06103
events.description: Marks the 161st anniversary of the 29th and 30th Connecticut Colored Regiments' return to Hartford in November 1865, after helping take Richmond. Opening ceremonies at 9:00 a.m.; the walk starts at 9:30 a.m. and follows the soldiers' parade route through downtown Hartford, starting and ending at the Old State House: 3.1 miles, with an optional one-mile route, and a live audio tour on your phone (bring headphones). Free. Hosted by the Alex Breanne Corporation with Connecticut's Old State House; register through SimpleTix.

events.title: Charity Bingo Fundraiser (VFW Post 449)
events.location: VFW Post 449, 197 Providence Street, West Warwick, RI
events.description: Charity bingo night at VFW Post 449. Doors open at 4:00 p.m.; bingo starts at 5:00 p.m. $40 per person. Raffles, plus $500 and $1,000 jackpots. For details call George Russell at (401) 206-9829.

events.title: British Soldiers' Wives in the American Revolution: A Talk with Author Don Hagist
events.location: The Museum at the John Brown House, 52 Power Street, Providence, RI 02906
events.description: Rhode Island Historical Society talk by author Don N. Hagist, based on his book Invisible Lives, on the wives of British soldiers during the American Revolution. Doors open 4:30pm for a reception and book signing; $10 general admission, $5 RIHS members; registration requested, seating limited.
